I need to build an app for a restaurant. It needs to be a very detailed, accurate income-expense database. It's a web app that can be inputted by either a CSV file or manual inputs. It needs to have full breakdowns for:

-   Tenants
-   Cash, card, account from the income side
-   Suppliers
-   Spending expenditures, whether it's cost to company on food, cost to company on booze, cost to company on decor, cost to company on R&M. The various departments broken down all the way to cleaning products
-   Rentals
-   POS rentals, credit card charges, bank charges
-   A full, full forensic audit monthly expense and income sheet. It needs to be highly detailed and highly user-friendly.
-   CVC-based inputs, as it'll be importing a lot from the POS system and a lot from supplier journals, statements, monthly dated accounts.

It all needs to be done from August of this year up until December now, current. So it needs to be fulfilled month-for-month.

Then it needs a section for reports. In reports, this should break down accurately what was spent per, per, per, per, but each department should have its own sheet where we can fill in the different things in.

It also attached to this, two loan accounts that need to be sorted.

**Constructing Restaurant Database**

I'm currently building a highly detailed restaurant income-expense database with a forensic audit tool, focusing on the period from August to December. I am adding a method to let the user import data via CSV or manual entry. The income categories will include Tenants, Cash, and Card transactions.


**Expanding Expense Categories**

I've significantly expanded the expense categories to include Food, Booze, Decor, R&M, and Cleaning Products. Operational costs, such as Rentals, POS rentals, and bank charges, are also incorporated. I'm introducing two loan accounts for detailed tracking. My goal is a forensic audit level of precision with department-specific sheets for a detailed monthly breakdown. This will allow the user to easily understand their business performance. I'm focusing on user-friendliness while achieving this level of accuracy.


**Building Analytical Views**

I'm now prioritizing the analytical components of the restaurant database project. I'm focusing on creating a high-density table that's grouped by month and category to facilitate robust analysis. The front-end will be built with React 18+, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. I'm leveraging Lucide React for icons and Recharts for data visualization, and considering PapaParse for CSV parsing. Local storage will handle persistence.


**Developing Detailed UI**

I'm now focusing on the user interface, aiming for a high-end financial dashboard look with a modern "Modern Enterprise" theme using Slate, Indigo, and Emerald color palettes. Expenses are organized under COGS (Food, Booze), Suppliers, Ops (Decor, R&M, Cleaning), and Financial. I'm also adding separate sections for loan accounts and implementing a robust CSV processor, initially misunderstood as "CVC-based", and will implement a balance check feature for cross-referencing.
